items.description:
Riaphela General Services cc is a 100% Historically Disadvantaged Individual-owned company based in Silverton, Pretoria, set up to serve the development needs of South Africa and support delivery of the government's People's Contract. The business works with local authorities to address the development needs of their constituencies, with core competence in infrastructural development aimed at building stronger local economies while developing people.

It describes itself as skilled and experienced in technical planning and implementation, community development and project management, drawing on a practical understanding of South Africa's development management needs to help clients across different sectors meet national policy goals. The company operates under the motto 'Future For All', built on values of development with integrity, accountability and inclusiveness. As part of its social responsibility commitments, Riaphela has, since 2004, assisted more than ten civil and building graduates from universities and colleges to complete their practical studies, and has also built houses for underprivileged residents in Johannesburg in partnership with AMAHA (African Musicians Against HIV and Aids).

RMS Projects (Pty) Ltd is a waterproofing, painting and damp-proofing specialist based in Eldo Lakes Estate, serving both private homeowners and commercial clients. Its core services span water leak detection, waterproofing, painting and damp-proofing, including electrophysical wall dehumidification treatments aimed at removing rising damp from walls.

The company positions itself as a specialist in protecting property, using a range of techniques and materials chosen to suit each individual site, from leak detection through to the finishing paint work. Projects are handled by a team the company describes as accredited and certified in their respective fields, with each job - regardless of its size or scope - treated as a distinct undertaking tailored to the client's needs and the condition of the property. The business frames its work as combining technical proficiency with an understanding of the client's vision for the property, so that the finished result is both structurally sound and visually presentable. Being based in the Eldo Lakes Estate / Eldo Glen area gives it convenient reach into the greater Centurion area for both residential waterproofing and damp repairs and small-to-medium commercial projects requiring leak detection or protective painting.

Rock Engineering Africa (Pty) Ltd is a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy operating from Workshop No. 5, 47 Robyn Street in the Klerksoord area of Akasia, Pretoria North. The business is listed under the engineering category and describes itself as delivering engineering services and products to the mining industry as well as to construction companies, combining consulting work with practical, product-based solutions rather than design advice alone. Operating from a dedicated workshop premises rather than a standard office suite suggests the company carries out some of its engineering or fabrication work on site, supporting clients in sectors where equipment reliability and technical back-up are important.

Being based in Akasia, on the northern edge of Pretoria, places Rock Engineering Africa within reach of the mining and industrial activity north and west of the city, as well as the broader Pretoria North construction sector it serves alongside its consulting work for mining clients.

SBP Ceilings is a ceiling and drywalling specialist serving homes and businesses in Pretoria and the surrounding areas from its base in Koedoespoort Industrial. The company's core offering covers ceiling and drywall installation and repairs, along with bulkheads, cornices and Rhinolite finishes, and it extends into acoustic and specialist systems for spaces where sound control matters, such as quieter drywall rooms.

For commercial clients, SBP plans drywalling and suspended-ceiling installations around the specific layout and operating needs of the business, rather than offering a one-size-fits-all finish. The company also provides painting and project management services alongside its ceiling and drywall work, and states that it uses SABS-approved products in its installations. It is owner-managed, with the business describing its approach as centred on attention to detail across every stage of a project, from the initial ceiling structure through to the final finish. Based in the Koedoespoort Industrial area, SBP Ceilings is positioned to serve both residential ceiling and bulkhead work and larger commercial interior fit-outs across greater Pretoria.

SMS Gateway is a marketing and advertising agency based in Erasmia, Centurion, offering digital campaign services to businesses looking to build their online presence. Its core offering includes tailored digital marketing campaigns, social media management, search engine optimisation (SEO) and pay-per-click (PPC) advertising.

The agency describes its approach as client-focused and practical, aiming to deliver measurable results through transparent reporting rather than one-off, generic campaigns. Its premises on Bart Joubert Street include wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance, making the office reasonably accessible to visiting clients. Being based in Erasmia gives SMS Gateway convenient reach into the wider Centurion market, where it positions itself as a local alternative to larger metro-based marketing agencies, working directly with small and medium businesses on customised solutions for their specific goals rather than templated packages. The combination of SEO, PPC and social media management under one roof allows the agency to run and measure a client's digital presence across multiple channels from a single point of contact.

Sportsmans Warehouse Centurion trades from Shop 2 at Byls Bridge Promenade on Koaline Drive in Highveld, Centurion, as part of the national Sportsmans Warehouse chain. The store is categorised as a sporting goods store that also covers clothing, footwear, outdoor sports equipment and sportswear, reflecting a broad range that spans running, cycling, fitness and general outdoor gear rather than a single sporting code.

Customer feedback on the store points to a dedicated running shoe department staffed by sales assistants who help fit and advise on footwear. The branch keeps extended trading hours across the week, including Saturday and Sunday trade, which suits shoppers picking up sports and outdoor equipment over the weekend. Its location at Byls Bridge Promenade places it alongside other sport and fitness-related retailers in the same precinct, making the centre a convenient stop for Centurion residents assembling kit for running, gym, cycling or outdoor activities in one visit.

Sting Wood is a timber and pallet supplier operating from Hendrik van Eck Street in the Rosslyn/Akasia area of Pretoria, trading under the forestry and logging category. The business specialises in imported recycled wood and pallets sold directly to the public, giving customers access to reclaimed timber rather than only new-cut stock. Alongside recycled wood, Sting Wood deals in pallets that can be reused for furniture, storage, landscaping or other DIY projects, appealing to both tradespeople and home-based woodworkers. The company has built a following of thousands on social media, where it regularly promotes month-end specials and other promotions on its timber and pallet stock, and customer feedback describes it as good value for money. Its focus on imported and recycled wood, rather than a single timber species, means stock on hand can vary, and customers have asked about the range of wood types available, including pine.

Based in the Rosslyn industrial area of Pretoria, the business serves both retail customers and small-scale builders needing timber or pallets for projects across the wider Pretoria North area.

items.description:
Tattoo Academy is a tattoo and piercing studio based on Codonia Avenue in Moregloed, Pretoria. The studio's listed services cover both tattooing and tattoo removal, alongside body piercing and more specific piercing services such as ear piercing and nose piercing, giving clients a single venue for both permanent ink work and piercing procedures.

Offering tattoo removal alongside tattooing suggests the studio caters to clients adjusting or correcting existing tattoo work as well as those getting new pieces done. The range of piercing options, from general body piercing through to ear and nose piercing specifically, points to a studio equipped to handle a variety of piercing placements rather than a narrow specialty. Located in Moregloed, the studio sits within reach of surrounding Pretoria suburbs such as Villieria and Waverley, placing it among a cluster of beauty and personal care businesses in the area. Clients considering tattoo or piercing work in the area can access tattooing, piercing and removal services at this single Moregloed location.

ThaKgo Facility Solutions is a facility services provider based in Karenpark, Pretoria, offering clients a combined package of cleaning services, facility maintenance, security services, and grounds and property management. The business positions itself as available and reliable, aiming to give the same level of attention to small jobs as to larger contracts rather than prioritising only big accounts. Its stated operating values include respect, integrity, continuous learning, innovation, adaptability and teamwork, which the company presents as the basis for how it manages client relationships and day-to-day service delivery. By covering cleaning, maintenance, security and grounds management under one provider, ThaKgo allows commercial clients to consolidate several facility-related contracts rather than managing separate suppliers for each service.

The company operates from its Karenpark office during standard weekday business hours, and its stated approach of taking responsibility for execution reflects a model built around running the day-to-day upkeep of a client's premises so the client can focus on their core business instead.

Vanrail Supplies (Pty) Ltd is a manufacturer and supplier of engineering products and services exclusively to the rolling stock industry, operating from Hennopspark, Centurion. Established in 1992, the company initially supplied mechanical and pneumatic products to the South African Railways before expanding its reach.

Today, together with its sister company Van Heerden Railway Enterprises (Pty) Ltd, based in Montagu in the Western Cape, Vanrail supplies rail-related products to railroads across the African continent and beyond. Its vertically integrated manufacturing range includes air, vacuum and steam hose assemblies; air brake equipment such as end cocks, dirt collectors, brake cylinders, tee-pieces and pressure taps; cast, machined and fabricated wagon and coach components; and steel pipe assemblies with threaded or flanged ends and associated fittings. The company also repairs and services air and vacuum brake equipment, and works with an extensive network of suppliers providing castings, forgings, pressings, and welded or fabricated products to widen the range it can offer rail operators. Vanrail is also noted as the exclusive Southern African representative for Graham-White Manufacturing, reinforcing its specialised focus on rolling-stock engineering rather than general industrial supply.

items.description:
Wired @ Wonderpark is a compact internet cafe in Karenpark, Pretoria, situated next to the Wonderpark Mini Market within the Wonderpark Estates complex. The business offers practical, walk-in tech services including computer repair, document printing and laminating, alongside general internet access for browsing or completing online tasks.

Customers can print documents, use the available computers, and have a coffee while work is being carried out or while waiting for assistance, giving the space a more relaxed, cafe-style feel rather than a purely functional repair counter. The venue is wheelchair accessible via its parking area, and it keeps extended weekday hours through to early evening, with shorter Saturday trading and no Sunday trade. Its position beside Wonderpark Mini Market means it benefits from passing shopper traffic in the Wonderpark Estates precinct, making it a convenient stop for Karenpark-area customers needing quick printing, laminating or computer repair without travelling further into central Pretoria.

Woolworths' Castle Walk branch trades from the Castle Walk Shopping Centre at the corner of Lois and Nossob Streets in Erasmuskloof, operating as a grocery store within the centre. The branch keeps extended hours from early morning through to the evening on weekdays and Saturdays, with shorter Sunday trading, giving shoppers a wide trading window for grocery runs.

It sits among several other Woolworths grocery branches in the surrounding south-eastern Pretoria area, including stores at Castle Gate, Garsfontein Village and Moreleta Village, reflecting the chain's dense coverage of the Erasmuskloof, Garsfontein and Moreleta Park suburbs. Customer feedback on the branch highlights its early weekday opening time and generally well-stocked shelves and fresh produce section, with occasional suggestions from shoppers for an in-store bakery counter. Positioned inside a neighbourhood shopping centre rather than a large regional mall, the Castle Walk branch functions as a convenient, everyday grocery stop for residents of Erasmuskloof and the immediately surrounding streets.

Woolworths Olympus Village is a grocery store trading from the Olympus Village centre at the corner of Olympus Drive and Achilles Road in Olympus, Pretoria. The branch offers fresh produce, pantry essentials and deli items, alongside in-store shopping, in-store pickup for online orders and home delivery, with card payments accepted across all of these options.

Shoppers can also stop for a quick coffee while shopping, in keeping with the store's positioning as a relaxed, everyday grocery destination rather than a large-format supermarket. The branch keeps extended hours seven days a week, opening at 8am on weekdays and Saturdays and 9am on Sundays, closing in the early evening each day. Wheelchair-accessible parking and entrances are available on site. The store has built up a substantial base of customer reviews rating the shopping experience highly, reflecting steady use by residents of Olympus and the surrounding smallholdings area who rely on it for fresh groceries, deli staples and convenient order collection or delivery close to home.

items.description:
4Sight Holdings Ltd is a multinational, diversified technology group listed on the General Segment of the JSE Main Board under the ticker 4SI, with a presence in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. The group brings together people, data and intelligent technologies across four business clusters: Operational Technologies, Information Technologies, Business Environment and a Channel Partner network, allowing it to offer connected digital transformation services spanning the full journey from strategy through to deployment.

Its work is framed around what it calls 'Enterprise 5.0', an approach built on its own automated intelligence technology, '4AI', aimed at moving organisations from having no real-time visibility of their operations ('no-sight') through to full predictive insight ('foresight') using hybrid cloud technologies and real-time data. As a JSE-listed, multinational group operating across the private and public sectors, 4Sight services both large corporate and public-sector clients looking to modernise operational technology, IT infrastructure and business processes together rather than as separate projects. The company also runs an AI-based chatbot, powered by Microsoft Copilot, to help stakeholders navigate its integrated reports and investor documentation.

About IT Group is an IT consulting and managed services provider founded in 2003, serving medium to large enterprises from its base in the Garsfontein area of Pretoria. The company's core focus areas include on-premise and cloud ERP implementation, payroll systems, secure Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), and data analytics, positioning it as a single partner for enterprises looking to modernise several layers of their business systems together.

Since 2023, About IT Group has operated as a Sage Platinum Partner, reselling and implementing Sage ERP and accounting products alongside its own customisation and long-term managed support services, which it presents as central to helping clients maximise efficiency and profitability from their systems. Client feedback cited by the company includes a travel and leisure sector client who has worked with About IT Group since 2017, describing the relationship as one where the company adds value beyond standard support and adapts its service to the client's specific business requirements. Having operated in the Pretoria market for over two decades, About IT Group combines established ERP and payroll expertise with newer data analytics and cloud infrastructure services for its enterprise client base.

Absolute Hosting is a web hosting provider based in Centurion Golf Estate, offering a range of hosting and related infrastructure services to South African businesses and individuals. Its product range spans Linux web hosting on DirectAdmin, NVMe-based WordPress hosting with free SSL and domain registration, and AMD EPYC-powered NVMe cPanel hosting that includes a free AI website builder.

For larger or custom deployments, the company also offers .NET Core hosting and Linux reseller hosting packages built on SSD storage. Beyond website hosting, Absolute Hosting provides several tiers of email hosting, including basic business email, POPI-compliant managed email hosting for organisations with stricter security and compliance needs, and personal email hosting with larger mailbox storage under a user's own domain. It also runs bulk SMTP services for businesses that need to send high volumes of transactional or marketing email without throttling. The company states that its servers are hosted in a Tier IV data centre, the top data-centre reliability classification, reflecting an emphasis on uptime and infrastructure resilience for the hosting and email services it sells to its South African client base.

items.description:
Adelaars Restaurant & Venue is a family-style restaurant and pub on 16th Avenue in Wonderboom South, serving the wider Moot area of Pretoria. Beyond its day-to-day restaurant trade, the business also operates as a performance and event venue, hosting functions alongside its regular food and drink service.

Customers can dine in, order takeaway, or sit outdoors, giving the venue flexibility for both casual weekday meals and larger group bookings or events. It is positioned in its own marketing as a neighbourhood 'go-to spot' for food in the Moot, reflecting a focus on local, regular trade rather than destination dining. The venue operates in a lower-to-mid price bracket, and has built up a loyal social media following with thousands of followers engaging with its posts. With its combined restaurant, pub and events offering under one roof, Adelaars gives Wonderboom South residents a single local venue for everyday meals as well as functions, parties or performances, extending its role beyond that of a typical neighbourhood eatery.

Afrikaanse Hoer Meisieskool (AHMP) is an Afrikaans-medium public girls' school based on Bond Street in Clydesdale, Pretoria. The school operates with its own governing body and a defined leadership structure, and promotes itself as a school anchored in history and tradition. Beyond the classroom, AHMP maintains a dedicated school shop ('Affie-winkel') for uniforms and school-branded items, and offers pupils a choice of academic subjects as they progress through their schooling. The school places strong emphasis on cultural and extracurricular activity, running its own choir and orchestra programmes for musically inclined pupils, as well as a public-speaking and debating programme known as 'Redenaars', giving pupils structured opportunities to develop performance and argumentation skills outside the academic curriculum. Facilities information and an open day and application process are available directly through the school for prospective pupils and parents.

Based in Clydesdale, AHMP serves girls from across Pretoria seeking an Afrikaans-medium school environment that combines academic subject choice with established music, choir and public-speaking traditions.

items.description:
American Battery Company Moot is a branch of the American Battery Company franchise, based on Nico Smith Street in Rietfontein, Pretoria. The branch supplies a range of vehicle batteries sized for different needs, from smaller 40Ah batteries suited to basic vehicles without extra electronics, through to 50Ah and 60Ah options for vehicles with additional features such as air conditioning and demisting, up to 70Ah batteries intended for medium-sized luxury vehicles with higher power demands.

Batteries sold through the branch come with a warranty, and the store states it does not charge customers a scrap fee when an old battery is handed in as part of a replacement, which is a cost some battery retailers pass on to customers. As part of a chain with other branches, including one in nearby Silverton, the Moot branch allows customers in the Rietfontein and wider Moot area of Pretoria to get battery testing, fitting and replacement without needing to travel into central Pretoria, matching a specific battery capacity to their vehicle's electrical load rather than a single generic size.

Art Motor Engineering CC is a motor engineering workshop based on Plantation Street in Silverton, Pretoria. The business is categorised as a motor engineering operation specialising in engine reconditioning, completed alongside general vehicle servicing and repairs.

Offering engine reconditioning as a dedicated specialism, rather than only basic servicing, suggests the workshop is equipped to handle more involved mechanical work such as rebuilding or restoring worn engines, in addition to routine maintenance and repair jobs that keep vehicles roadworthy day to day. Based in the Silverton industrial and light-commercial area of Pretoria, the workshop is positioned within reach of the area's vehicle owners and smaller transport operators who need engine-level mechanical work done locally rather than through a dealership. Operating on a weekday and Saturday morning schedule, the business is set up to serve both private vehicle owners and, given its industrial-area location, operators of light commercial vehicles requiring reconditioning or repair work in the Silverton area.

ARY Motors is a used-car dealership based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria West, trading under the tagline 'Driving Trust. Delivering Quality.' The dealership allows customers to browse its vehicle inventory to buy a car, or to sell or trade in an existing vehicle through the same business. Stock advertised by the dealership has included hatchbacks, compact SUVs and sedans such as a Volkswagen Polo GTI, Ford EcoSport and Toyota Corolla Quest, indicating a focus on everyday, mass-market used vehicles rather than a single vehicle segment. Enquiries on specific vehicles are handled directly through the dealership, and the business promotes itself around straightforward, low-hassle buying and selling, positioning trade-ins and vehicle sales as a more direct, personal process than larger corporate dealerships typically offer.

Based in Proclamation Hill, ARY Motors serves buyers and sellers across Pretoria West looking for affordable second-hand vehicles, combining a retail stock of used cars with a trade-in and vehicle-sale service for customers looking to dispose of their current car as part of a purchase.

AUDITSA Auditors & Accountants is based in Lombardy Business Park in Shere, Pretoria, offering financial audit, accounting and advisory services to businesses in the area. The firm's core offering covers thorough financial audits alongside ongoing accounting support and more general advisory services for business clients, combining compliance-focused audit work with day-to-day accounting assistance under one roof. It operates on a standard Monday-to-Friday schedule, with wheelchair-accessible parking available at its Lombardy Business Park premises. Client feedback on the firm highlights a friendly and knowledgeable team as a particular strength, suggesting a smaller, relationship-based practice rather than a large corporate audit firm.

Based in Shere, AUDITSA serves businesses across the surrounding Pretoria East business-park area, giving local companies access to audit and accounting expertise without needing to engage a firm based further into central Pretoria. The combination of audit, accounting and advisory services means clients can use AUDITSA for both statutory compliance work and more general financial guidance as their business needs evolve.

Azariah Pharmaceuticals (Pty) Ltd is a family-owned pharmaceutical company based in Waverley, Pretoria, involved in the research, development, manufacturing and quality control of its own pharmaceutical products. The company describes its approach as people-orientated, stating that its values are reflected in how it treats patients, customers, employees and partners alike.

Rather than operating purely as a contract manufacturer, Azariah is involved across the full product lifecycle, from research and development through to production and quality control, which it presents as central to ensuring the safety and effectiveness of what it makes. The business also networks with partners internationally, aiming to bring additional expertise and innovation into its own product development process. Azariah frames its mission as delivering exceptional products for everyone, with a stated vision of enhancing people's lives through its product range. Based in Waverley, the company forms part of Pretoria's pharmaceutical manufacturing base, combining an in-house research and development capability with its own production and quality-control processes rather than outsourcing these functions.

B2IT is a data, analytics and automation consultancy based in Monument Park, Pretoria, working as a Qlik partner alongside Microsoft's data and automation tools. Its services span three main areas: AI and analytics using the Qlik and Microsoft platforms, including Qlik Sense, QlikView migration, Qlik Cloud Analytics, Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric; data integration and quality work covering data movement, transformation, data lake creation and data governance; and process automation using UiPath for robotic and agentic automation, FlowCentric Processware for business process management, and the Microsoft Power Platform for low-code apps and workflows.

The company has worked with large corporate clients including Red Bull, where it helped improve insights generation and decision-making within the FMCG business, and African Barrick Gold, which has used B2IT since 2010 to develop, implement and support Qlik-based business models. By combining analytics, data engineering and automation under one roof, B2IT positions itself as a partner that can take a client from raw source data through to trusted dashboards and automated business processes, rather than specialising in only one part of that pipeline.

Barcelos is a flame-grilled peri-peri chicken restaurant on Robert Sobukwe Street in Trevenna, trading as part of the national and international Barcelos chain, which was founded in Pretoria in 1993. The brand's food preparation method is central to its identity: chicken is flame-grilled rather than fried or boiled, and every piece is marinated for a full 24 hours in the chain's peri-peri blend before cooking, which Barcelos presents as key to its flavour and texture.

The chain sources chicken that is prepared centrally before distribution to individual restaurants, aiming for consistent quality across its locations, and markets its flame-grilling method as a lower-oil, better-for-you alternative to fried chicken. Having grown from its Pretoria roots over more than 30 years, Barcelos now operates more than 120 restaurants across over a dozen countries, making the Trevenna branch part of a long-established, large-scale franchise network rather than an independent takeaway. For customers in Trevenna and the surrounding Sunnyside area, the restaurant offers the chain's standard flame-grilled chicken and side-dish menu for sit-down or takeaway orders.

Baroka Tombstones is a tombstone and granite memorial supplier based in Booysens, Pretoria, offering a dedicated catalogue of complete granite gravestones. Its 'Collection One: Full Graves' range covers full, base-to-crown granite tombstones across more than thirty different designs, giving customers a range of styles and sizes to choose from rather than a single standard memorial. The tombstones are offered in different granite types, including a lighter 'Rusternburg' granite and a darker 'Black Zim' granite, which vary in price according to the design and the type of stone used.

Beyond supplying complete tombstones, the business handles related granite work such as installation, cutting, engraving and repairs for existing memorials, serving families and funeral-related clients across the greater Pretoria area. Operating from Booysens, Baroka Tombstones gives customers a dedicated, Pretoria-based option for ordering and installing a granite gravestone, with a documented catalogue of pre-designed options that can be quoted and ordered directly rather than requiring a fully custom design process for every order.

Batho Bantsho Trading and Projects cc is a construction and contracting company based in East Lynne, Pretoria, offering renovation, extension and new-build services to clients in the area. The business positions its work around quality and clear collaboration with clients throughout a project, aiming to deliver a smooth, stress-free building experience from the initial planning stage through to completion. Covering renovations and extensions alongside full new-build projects means the company can take on both smaller alteration work for existing homes and larger ground-up construction jobs, rather than specialising narrowly in one type of build. The company describes its team as experienced, with customer satisfaction and quality workmanship presented as its central focus across the different types of construction work it undertakes.

Based in East Lynne, Batho Bantsho Trading and Projects serves clients across the surrounding eastern Pretoria suburbs, providing a single local contractor for homeowners who need anything from a small renovation to a complete new residential build managed by one team.

items.description:
Bevera is a beverage distribution business based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, acting as the official South African distributor for the Juss, Sariyer, Koffo and Black Bruin brands. Rather than selling directly to end consumers from its premises, Bevera supplies these beverage brands into a wide network of independent retailers, convenience stores, cafes, takeaways, bakeries and fuel-station forecourt shops across South Africa.

Its stockist list spans every province, from Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal to Limpopo, Mpumalanga, the Northern Cape, North West and the Western Cape, with a particularly dense concentration of stockists in and around Pretoria and Centurion, including stores and takeaways in Erasmia, Laudium, Eldoraigne and Lynwood. Businesses interested in stocking the Bevera product range can apply to become a stockist directly through the company. Operating from the Icon Industrial Park in Sunderland Ridge places Bevera within Centurion's established industrial and logistics corridor, giving it practical access for distributing stock both to its dense cluster of Pretoria-area outlets and to its wider national network of independent retailers.
